question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a brown ball, and Claire has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Finally, Claire and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) brown ball
(C) silver ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (white, brown, silver)
1. Claire swaps with Bob: (white, silver, brown)
2. Claire swaps with Alice: (brown, silver, white)
3. Claire swaps with Bob: (brown, white, silver)
Bob has the white ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
